JobDef.reportString: cooking supper at the camp fire.

li.label: good neighbors for a while
li.description: The people who camped near us traded with us, helped where they could, and left on good terms.

li.label: strangers on our land
li.description: They cut our trees and shoot our game, and nobody asked us first.

li.label: we drove off the camp
li.description: They hadn't done anything to us, and we sent them running anyway.

li.label: the camp helped us
li.description: The people at the camp did us a good turn and asked for nothing in return.

li.label: a friend moved on with the camp
li.description: I got to know someone at the camp. Now they've moved on, and I don't know if I'll see them again.

plain.li: [friend] {X_nameDef} from the camp left today. We used to sit at their fire after supper while {X_pronoun} told me about the places {X_pronoun}'d been.
[friend,left] The camp packed up this morning. {X_nameDef} gave me a carved spoon before going. I didn't have anything to give back.
[friend,traded] Traded with the camp one last time. {X_nameDef} talked me into a worse deal than I meant to make, and I didn't mind.
[friend,forced] We chased the camp off today. {X_nameDef} looked straight at me on the way out, and I couldn't look back.
[friend,fled] The camp scattered after what happened. I hope {X_nameDef} got away all right.
[friend,fight] I knew {X_nameDef} from the camp. Then we were on opposite sides of a fight, and I never saw what happened to {X_objective}.
[friend,fallout] The camp left angry. {X_nameDef} didn't say goodbye to me, and I'm not sure I blame {X_objective}.
[friend,hired] One of the camp stayed on with us when the rest left. I'd hoped it would be {X_nameDef}.
[resent] The camp is gone, and so are a good many of the trees out that way.
[resent] Strangers shooting deer within sight of our fields, for days. Nobody asked us.
[resent,forced] We ran the camp off today. About time.
[resent,fallout] The camp left in a temper. I won't miss them.
[resent,fight] They chose to fight us over a patch of woods. Now that's done.
[resent,helped] The camp left us some meat once. It was our meat to begin with, if you think about it.

warm.li: [friend] {X_nameDef} showed me how to keep a fire going all night on almost nothing. I'll miss that camp.
[friend,helped] The people at the camp left us medicine and meat and asked for nothing. {X_nameDef} was the one who thought of it.

blunt.li: [friend] Liked {X_nameDef}. Shame about the camp moving on.

cheerful.li: [friend,traded] Bought a whole sack of things from the camp's trader! {X_nameDef} threw in a spare whetstone.
[friend] {X_nameDef} taught me a song from the road. I've been humming it all day.

gloomy.li: [friend] {X_nameDef} moved on with the camp. People always move on.
[resent] Another lot of strangers living off our land. Next time it'll be raiders.

cold.li: [friend] The camp has left. {X_nameDef} was useful company while it lasted.
[resent] The camp took more than it gave. I kept count.
